subject: Application: Graduate Engineer - Roads and Highways, Sunshine Coast, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Graduate Engineer, Roads and Highways role on the Sunshine Coast through your LiveHire listing (job YMY8M), part of the Calibre Graduate Program.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project in charge and field engineer.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site, office and regional work and open to discussing relocation for the right graduate role. I do not yet have Australian consulting employment.

Your two-year graduate pathway in Transport on Roads and Highways matches the road and civil documentation work I studied.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com

Marc Darenz Masarate
